QUOTE: "**"Not definitive" wording** is a deliberate downgrade. It says the search is not an error and not a malformed call, and that the caller should look elsewhere before concluding absence."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes several "not definitive" downgrades (unread corpus, no file docs corpus, multi-token) and never says there is exactly one absent-corpus downgrade or that keeping it to one is deliberate to avoid blanket hedging.
